34void ASideScrollingJumpPad::BeginOverlap(AActor* OverlappedActor, AActor* OtherActor)
35{
36 // were we overlapped by a character?
37 if (ACharacter* OverlappingCharacter = Cast<ACharacter>(OtherActor))
38 {
39 // force the character to jump
40 OverlappingCharacter->Jump();
41
42 // launch the character to override its vertical velocity
43 FVector LaunchVelocity = FVector::UpVector * ZStrength;
44 OverlappingCharacter->LaunchCharacter(LaunchVelocity, false, true);
